events.title: CVE-2026-118633 — A path traversal vulnerability allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code as root in Sophos UTM (all versions) after
events.summary: A critical flaw (CVE-2026-118633) affects all releases of Sophos UTM. An unauthenticated remote attacker can repeatedly trigger a path traversal issue in the email proxy with scanning enabled, win a race condition over a few minutes, and execute code as root; the fix must be applied manually because the product is end-of-life.
events.why_it_matters: At CVSS 9.2 with unauthenticated, root-level code execution, this is a critical exposure for any remaining Sophos UTM deployment. The end-of-life status and manual patch requirement mean operators cannot rely on automated updates. Although the flaw is not listed in KEV, it still warrants urgent attention because only a few minutes of repeated attempts are needed to exploit the race condition.
